resources.string: Hands-free phone control with the camera. A white cursor follows your fingertip. AIR OS power, Arabic-first, built for everyday gestures.
Air Controle watches your hand — not your face — to move the cursor and read gestures. The feed stays on-device.
The Accessibility Service performs Home, Back, scroll, and tap at the cursor. Android requires you to turn this on yourself. You can disable it any time.
A white fingertip cursor draws over other apps so you can see where a gesture will land.
A persistent notification is how Android lets Air Control keep running after you leave the app. It is also the honest off switch.

Turn Air Control on from Home. Raise your hand — the white cursor appears and control starts. Open the Gesture guide for the full fixed set: point, pinch, scroll, swipe, palm pause, fist Back, and peace Home.
Finish onboarding permissions before turning Air Control on.
Accessibility is off — cursor can still move, but taps and system actions will not fire.
Turn on Air Controle in the list (package com.mulkallah.aircontrole).
Air Control stays on after you leave this screen. Android may still pause the camera if the system kills background work.
Raise an open palm 👋 in front of the front camera. Status should leave Idle and a white cursor should appear.
Air Control could not start the camera pipeline
The hand model is missing from this install. Reinstall the app, then turn Air Control on again.
Hand tracking failed to start. Force-stop Air Controle and try again. If it keeps failing, reboot the phone.
The front camera did not start. Close other camera apps, then tap retry.
The camera stopped unexpectedly. Turn Air Control off and on. On Samsung, set the app battery usage to Unrestricted.
The camera bound but sent no frames. On Samsung: Settings → Apps → Air Controle → Battery → Unrestricted. Then tap retry.
Camera permission was lost. Allow Camera, then tap retry.
The white cursor overlay could not be shown. Allow “Display over other apps”, then tap retry.
Samsung may pause the camera in the background. Set Air Controle battery usage to Unrestricted so the cursor keeps working.
Immediately stop Air Control, hide the cursor, and release the camera. This cannot force-close other apps on stock Android.
Air Controle is planned as a one-time purchase for 29.99 SAR. Billing is not wired in this build — this is a note only.

Stock Android will not let any app fully shut the phone down, survive every OEM battery killer, or inject input without Accessibility. Air Controle asks only for what it needs and tells you when the system is in the way.
The same fixed gestures for every user. Raise your hand to start — the white cursor appears, then the actions below run immediately (with a short cooldown so they do not spam).

👋 Raise an open palm or let your hand appear in the front camera. Air Control starts immediately, a white cursor/dot appears so you know tracking is on, and the Home status shows “control started” / tracking.
☝️ Point with your index finger and move it. The white cursor follows your fingertip on the screen so you can aim clicks.
🤏 Pinch thumb to index (then open again) to tap at the cursor. This is the click / tap gesture.
☝️⬆️ While pointing, flick your fingertip quickly upward. The screen scrolls up.
☝️⬇️ While pointing, flick your fingertip quickly downward. The screen scrolls down.
☝️➡️ While pointing, flick your fingertip quickly to the right. This performs a next / swipe-right on the current screen.
☝️⬅️ While pointing, flick your fingertip quickly to the left. This performs a previous / swipe-left on the current screen.
✋ After control has started, hold an open palm toward the camera to pause or resume Air Control. A brief 👋 raise only starts tracking; a longer ✋ hold pauses.
✊ Close your hand into a fist and hold it. This presses the system Back button.
✌️ Hold index and middle fingers up (peace / victory). This presses the system Home button.
